label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: User-supplied parameter NAME (from request.getParameterNames()) flows through conditional logic into bar, then into obj array, then into response.getWriter().format() HTML output. The parameter NAME is attacker-controllable via HTTP request construction. No HTML entity encoding is applied to bar before insertion into the formatted response string, allowing potential script injection. This constitutes a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User-provided parameter NAME captured into param when its value matches BenchmarkTest02315, flows through doSomething into bar, then into obj array, finally written to response via format() without HTML encoding
